description: EIP-2930 (Type 1) transaction - Transaction with access list
notes: EIP-2930 access list transaction from post-Berlin fork
Type 1 transaction with access list for gas optimization
Access list declares addresses and storage slots accessed
Helps save gas on cross-contract calls
RLP format: 0x01 || RLP([chainId, nonce, gasPrice, gasLimit, to, value, data, accessList, signatureYParity, r, s])
